numbering_note: This edition's item counts (240 sermons / 77 letters / 469 sayings) follow the Abduh recension exactly as OpenITI transcribed it. The more commonly cited Subhi al-Salih edition (used by thaqalayn.net, al-islam.org) numbers these slightly differently (241 / 79 / 480) because a handful of items are split or merged differently between the two recensions. Sermon/letter/saying NUMBERS in Noorium are therefore Abduh-edition numbers, not necessarily identical to the number the same passage carries elsewhere — the well-known items (e.g. Sermon 3 = Khutbat al-Shiqshiqiyya, Letter 53 = to Malik al-Ashtar) land at the same or a very close number in both editions.
